description.text: Program Description: 1. Learning 1000-1500 frequently-used Chinese Vocabulary 2. Achieving simple communication ability in Chinese and able to solve simple problems in daily life and study. Duration: one year

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Program at Beijing Language and Culture University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3222 USD/per year ￥ 23200 CNY/per year

materials.text: Scanned copy of the passport photo page. 2. Scanned copies of HSK and HSKK score reports (valid for two years). 3. Recommendation letter from the head of the recommending institution. 4. Highest academic degree certificate (or expected graduation certificate. Students who provide the expected graduation certificate must submit the official highest academic degree certificate before the start of the school term and registration date). Other materials to be submitted when applying for an academic course:

requirements.text: Non-Chinese nationals 2. Friendly towards China, with no criminal record, and abiding by the laws and regulations of the Chinese government as well as the school's rules and regulations. 3. Physically and mentally healthy, with excellent academic performance; 4. Those who are interested in engaging in Chinese language education, teaching and related fields; 5. Age range: 16 - 35 years old (calculated as September 1, 2025). For in-service Chinese teachers, the age limit is relaxed to 45 years old. For applicants for the undergraduate scholarship, the age should generally not exceed 25 years old.Enrollment in September 2025, with a funding period of 11 months. The professional direction is divided into two categories: (1) In the field of international Chinese education, the Chinese language examination score must reach 270 points in HSK (Level 3) and possess HSKK score. (2) Major in Chinese Language and Literature, Chinese History, or Chinese Philosophy. The Chinese language test score must reach 180 points in HSK (Level 4) and 60 points in HSKK (Intermediate Level). (3) For the Chinese language training program, candidates must achieve a HSK (Level 3) score of 210 or higher. Those who have obtained a HSKK score will be given priority.
